headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. In other action, the Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. The Tampa Bay Rays also secured a narrow victory, taking down the Chicago White Sox 1-0.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Atlanta Braves right-handed pitcher Reynaldo López, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation. The Los Angeles Dodgers have also placed RHP Will Klein on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading CF Lane Thomas and LHP Bailey Falter to the Atlanta Braves in exchange for LHP Carter Holton and RHP Lucas Braun.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert pitched 7 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 6 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox 1-0**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow victory over the Chicago White Sox, winning 1-0. Drew Rasmussen led the Rays' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Pintaro pitched 2 strong innings, striking out 3 batters with 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Braves RHP López Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves right-handed pitcher Reynaldo López has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left knee inflammation, with the move retroactive to July 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire LHP Carter Holton in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading CF Lane Thomas and LHP Bailey Falter to the Atlanta Braves in exchange for LHP Carter Holton and RHP Lucas Braun.
